title: TOLVAR EARTHWORKS
description: Dig it right. Move it once. A family excavating outfit's site sorted by where the dirt goes: cut, fill, pipe and haul, with a real job log and a spirit-level scroll bar.

sections.title: Header
sections.summary: level bar, logo, nav (The work, Job log, The yard, About, Crew), phone chip `(218) 555-0142`, "Free estimate" button. Hides on scroll down, returns on scroll up. One marker slides to the section being read. Full-screen phone menu with a focus trap and scroll lock.

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: diesel slab, two-line headline, lede, two buttons, two tickets ("Free estimates", "Licensed & insured"), a photo in the right half with a yellow job tag, a yellow grade line across the bottom.

sections.title: Ticker
sections.summary: a yellow band of all 20 service names, drifting.

sections.title: The work
sections.summary: "Dirt only moves four ways." Four tabs with a sliding yellow marker; each panel has a photo, a verb headline ("Dig it out.", "Build it up.", "Lay it in.", "Truck it."), a blurb, its services with one line each, and a "Get ___ work quoted" button that pre-selects that kind in the form. Services: Cut (Basements, Footers, Piers, Ponds & Waterfalls, Demolition, Clearing), Fill (Building Pads, Terraces, Yard Grades, Top Soil, Rock Walls, Excavating & Grading), Pipe (Water Lines, Storm Drains, Underground Utilities, Drainage Improvements), Haul (Hauling, Trucking Services, Dirt Work, Concrete).

sections.title: Job log
sections.summary: topsoil slab, filter chips (All, Cut, Fill, Pipe, Haul, Built on it) with counts, a multi-column grid of 22 photo tickets (job number, kind, title), and a native `<dialog>` viewer with previous, next, close and arrow keys.

sections.title: The yard
sections.summary: "We own the iron." Three photos and a fleet table (quantity, unit, size, what it does), ten units.

sections.title: About
sections.summary: owner photo and story, three tickets, four count-up stats (25 years in the seat, 20 kinds of work, 10 machines, 3 counties).

sections.title: Crew
sections.summary: diesel slab, "Three seats open." Accordion of Laborer, Operator, Foreman with requirements; terms; mailto button.

sections.title: Estimate
sections.summary: phones, email, address (4410 Tamarack Pit Road, Aitkin, MN 56431), hours, counties, an 811 note; a form with kind-of-work chips, first name, last name, email, mobile phone (all required), company and comments. Local validation, a short "writing the ticket" state, then a ticket confirmation. No network request.

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: hatch strip, oversized "Move it once.", nav, contacts, a line saying the company is fictional.
